# IN on an enum field
plan IN ('pro', 'team')

# NOT IN on an enum field
plan NOT IN ('free')

# IN on a joined field
country IN ('France', 'Japan')

# NOT IN keeps rows where the field is NULL
country NOT IN ('France', 'Germany')

# ... unless the list holds NULL
country NOT IN ('France', NULL)

# A NULL item in IN matches NULL rows
country IN ('Brazil', NULL)

# IN on an integer field, quoted and unquoted numbers mixed
age IN (17, '30', 99)

# NOT IN on a float field keeps NULL heights
height NOT IN (1.6, 1.8)

# IN on a boolean field with NULL
active IN (TRUE, NULL)

# IN on a uuid field
uid IN ('00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001', '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000013')

# IN on a date field
due IN ('2026-10-27', '2026-10-30')

# IN on a timestamp field compares instants
created_at IN ('2026-10-27T09:30:00Z', '2026-10-20T13:00:00+02:00')

# IN on text is exact and case-sensitive
name IN ('Ann Lee', 'bob stone')

# not in, in lower case
plan not in ('free', 'pro')
